blocks.title: Molar volume
blocks.text: STP (standard temperature and pressure, miyari darja hararat aur dabao) par ideal gas ke ek mole ka hajm molar volume, Vm, kehlata hai. Is ki qeemat 22.414 dm3 hai, jo aam taur par 22.4 dm3 gol ki jati hai.

Molar volume se STP par gas ka mass ya moles hajm mein aur ulat badle ja sakte hain. Avogadro's law ke mutabiq, ek jaise darja hararat aur dabao par sab ideal gases ke barabar hajm mein molecules ki barabar tadaad hoti hai. Yeh bil-wasta wahi baat hai ke 273.16 K aur ek atmosphere par ideal gas ke ek mole ka hajm 22.414 dm3 hai; kyunke ek mole mein Avogadro's number zarraat hain, STP par kisi bhi ideal gas ke 22.414 dm3 mein 6.02 x 10^23 molecules hain. To STP par gas ka 22.4 dm3 = gas ka molar mass = 6.02 x 10^23 zarraat = 1 mole. Agar gas ke moles maloom hon to us ka hajm moles zarb molar volume hai: V = n x Vm.

blocks.prompt: 4 g He, 17 g NH3 aur 64 g SO2 STP par har ek 22.414 dm3 lete hain halanke un ke molecules size aur mass mein bohat mukhtalif hain. Wazahat karein.
blocks.explanation: Har mass apni gas ka ek mole hai, to har ek mein 6.02 x 10^23 molecules hain. Avogadro's law se ek jaise darja hararat aur dabao par ideal gas molecules ki barabar tadaad barabar hajm leti hai, kyunke ideal gas ka hajm molecules ki tadaad par munhasir hai, un ke size ya mass par nahi; STP par ek mole hamesha 22.414 dm3 hai.

items: Molar volume Vm: STP (273.16 K, 1 atm) par ideal gas ka ek mole 22.414 dm3 leta hai, jo 22.4 dm3 liya jata hai; Avogadro's law: barabar hajm, molecules ki barabar tadaad.
STP par kisi bhi gas ka 22.4 dm3 = grams mein molar mass = 6.02 x 10^23 molecules = 1 mol; V = n x Vm.
